description:
Execute a pinch-to-zoom gesture by moving two fingers toward or away from a center point to change the scale of on-screen content. Positions and distances are fractions of the screen (0.0–1.0, not pixels), as in gesture-tap.
startDistance > endDistance = pinch in (zoom out). startDistance < endDistance = pinch out (zoom in).
Typical values: startDistance 0.2, endDistance 0.6 for a zoom-in pinch at screen center.
Use when you need to zoom in or out on a map, image, or zoomable view. Returns { pinched: true, timestampMs }. On physical iOS, reactivated: true = app was re-fronted; re-describe. Fails if the simulator-server / emulator backend is not reachable for the given device, or on a physical iPhone when the app is not drawn in portrait.

angle.description: Angle in degrees of the axis the fingers lie on: 0 = horizontal (default), 90 = vertical.

endCenterX.description: Final horizontal center of the pinch. When set, the centroid drifts linearly from centerX to endCenterX over the gesture (e.g. to keep expanding fingers on-screen near an edge). Omit for a fixed center.

endCenterY.description: Final vertical center of the pinch; drifts from centerY like endCenterX. Omit for a fixed center.

endDistance.description: Final distance between the two fingers.

startDistance.description: Initial distance between the two fingers.

udid.description: Target device id from `list-devices` (iOS UDID or Android serial).

name: gesture-pinch
